children.text: Acacius is studying strings theory. Today he came with the following problem.

You are given a string $$$s$$$ of length $$$n$$$ consisting of lowercase English letters and question marks. It is possible to replace question marks with lowercase English letters in such a way that a string "
" occurs as a substring in a resulting string exactly once?
Each question mark should be replaced with
lowercase English letter. For example, string "
", but can't be transformed into strings "

Occurrence of a string $$$t$$$ of length $$$m$$$ in the string $$$s$$$ of length $$$n$$$ as a substring is a index $$$i$$$ ($$$1 \leq i \leq n - m + 1$$$) such that string $$$s[i..i+m-1]$$$ consisting of $$$m$$$ consecutive symbols of $$$s$$$ starting from $$$i$$$-th equals to string $$$t$$$. For example string "
" has two occurrences of a string "
" as a substring with $$$i = 1$$$ and $$$i = 3$$$, but there are no occurrences of a string "
Please help Acacius to check if it is possible to replace all question marks with lowercase English letters in such a way that a string "
" occurs as a substring in a resulting string
First line of input contains an integer $$$T$$$ ($$$1 \leq T \leq 5000$$$), number of test cases. $$$T$$$ pairs of lines with test case descriptions follow.
The first line of a test case description contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$7 \leq n \leq 50$$$), length of a string $$$s$$$.
The second line of a test case description contains string $$$s$$$ of length $$$n$$$ consisting of lowercase English letters and question marks.
For each test case output an answer for it.
In case if there is no way to replace question marks in string $$$s$$$ with a lowercase English letters in such a way that there is exactly one occurrence of a string "
" in the resulting string as a substring output "
" and in the next line output a resulting string consisting of $$$n$$$ lowercase English letters. If there are multiple possible strings, output any.
You may print every letter in "
" in any case you want (so, for example, the strings
will all be recognized as positive answer).
